user.title: Connect an Orgaia group
user.description:
In the Orgaia app, open the group, go to **Manage › Home Assistant** and create a link. Paste it here. An admin of the group then confirms Home Assistant in the app.

Everything stays end-to-end encrypted: Home Assistant gets its own key and reads the group like a member. It is not counted as a person.

data_description.link: The link from the app, starting with https://…/join# or orgaia://join?
data_description.name: How Home Assistant appears to the group's admins.

reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant is no longer a member of {group}. Create a new link for Home Assistant in the app and paste it here.

progress.wait_for_admin: The request has been sent. An admin of **{group}** now confirms Home Assistant in the Orgaia app. This window waits up to 10 minutes. Compare the safety number with the one the app shows: **{code}**

error.invalid_link: This is not an Orgaia invitation link.
error.cannot_connect: The Orgaia service could not be reached.
error.needs_plus: Home Assistant can only join groups with Orgaia Plus.

error.invite_invalid: The link has expired or was already used. Create a new one in the app.
error.already_member: Home Assistant is already a member of this group.

needs_plus.title: Orgaia Plus ended for {group}
needs_plus.description: Home Assistant can read **{group}** only while the group has Orgaia Plus. Renew Plus in the app; Home Assistant picks up again by itself.

update_required.title: Update the Orgaia integration
update_required.description: The Orgaia service no longer accepts this version of the integration, so **{group}** is not updated. Install the latest version in HACS and restart Home Assistant.

init.title: People of the group
init.description: Choose which Home Assistant person each person of the group is. Events and person sensors then also name the person entity, e.g. for notifications. People with the same name are suggested.

abort.not_loaded: The group is not loaded right now. Try again once it is connected.
abort.no_persons: The group has no people yet.
